summary: Never thought about extra knowledge/work required as gentrification metaphor. Gonna think on it as we try to on board people to web. Yet let's not forget everyone started as a renter. LiveJournal, Friendster, MySpace, Geocities. Silos die but silos give life.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Never thought about extra knowledge/work required as gentrification metaphor. Gonna think on it as we try to on board people to web.

Yet let's not forget everyone started as a renter. LiveJournal, Friendster, MySpace, Geocities. Silos die but silos give life.
